recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（singlets gate）：絕大多數事件落在 CD19 陰性、CD56 陽性象限（81.08%），CD19+ 細胞極少，符合骨髓瘤漿細胞常見的異常表現型（CD19−/CD56+）。
features: Dot plot: CD19 ECD (x-axis) versus CD56 APC700 (y-axis), gated on singlets
Dominant population in the CD19-negative/CD56-positive quadrant (81.08%)
Lineage of the CD56+ population is not shown on this plot and requires CD38/CD138 and cytoplasmic kappa/lambda gating
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD19 versus CD56 on the singlet gate shows a dominant population (81.08%) that is CD19-negative and CD56-positive, with only rare CD19-positive events. In the context of a plasma cell neoplasm, loss of CD19 with aberrant CD56 expression is the characteristic neoplastic plasma cell immunophenotype, in contrast to normal plasma cells, which are typically CD19+/CD56-. Plasma cell identity (bright CD38, CD138) and cytoplasmic light-chain restriction are not displayed here and should be confirmed. Findings are supportive of a clonal plasma cell neoplasm such as plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Normal plasma cells are predominantly CD19-positive and CD56-negative with polytypic cytoplasmic light chains, whereas this population is CD19-negative/CD56-positive.
NK cells are also CD19-/CD56+ but are CD45-bright, CD38-dim, CD138-negative and express CD2/CD7/CD16, which requires additional gating to exclude.
Neuroendocrine tumor cells can be CD56+/CD19- but are CD45- and CD38/CD138-negative and express cytokeratin and synaptophysin on IHC.
